objective: Implement measured runtime, isolation, and tooling improvements from the cleanup review.

contractsChanged: No exported API signatures, wire schemas, or database schemas changed.
Limited columnar reads now enforce canonical order when publication order differs.
Internal audience cache keys use unambiguous length framing.
Updater script and CLI update/refresh add --skip-deps. Dependency commands have a configurable 120-second deadline.
Coverage checks reject incomplete or failed measurements before baseline updates.
invariants: Tenant and audience scope remain authoritative on projection reads.
Immutable entries stay internal; returned vector and borrowed-view ownership rules remain unchanged.
Ordering is descending UpdatedAt, descending version, ascending RecordID.
Headers retain their exact values and independent response ownership.
Allocation ceilings only decrease and coverage floors only increase.
scopeBoundary: Foundation Core runtime internals, Core-owned scaffold distribution, and enforcement tooling. No consuming application was changed.
fallback: Unordered limited selection inspects candidates with a bounded heap. A concurrent proof invalidation triggers at most one rescan.
Uncacheable projection requests retain the uncached path.
Missing Perl prevents an unbounded command. Deadline expiry terminates its process group.
Dependency synchronization can run manually after --skip-deps or a reported failure.
